# Crystal: three hexagonal shards (bipyramids) on a low hexagonal plinth. The scene bakes it twice:
# dark (ember) and glowing (glow, unlit). Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Plinth --base-color 0.1569 0.1020 0.1765 --no-slot
material new Shard --base-color 0.4196 0.1373 0.2549 --no-slot
add mesh cylinder --name Plinth --vertices 6 --radius 0.3 --depth 0.18 --location 0 0 0.09
material assign Plinth
mode edit
select face where "normal.z < -0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object
add mesh cylinder --name M0 --vertices 6 --radius 0.17 --depth 0.5 --location 0 0 0.43
add mesh cone --name M1 --vertices 6 --radius1 0.17 --radius2 0 --depth 0.36 --location 0 0 0.86
add mesh cylinder --name A0 --vertices 6 --radius 0.1 --depth 0.26 --location 0 0 0.13
add mesh cone --name A1 --vertices 6 --radius1 0.1 --radius2 0 --depth 0.22 --location 0 0 0.37
select A0 A1
active A0
join
set rotation 0 28 0
apply --rotation
set location 0.17 0.04 0.12
apply --location
add mesh cylinder --name B0 --vertices 6 --radius 0.09 --depth 0.2 --location 0 0 0.1
add mesh cone --name B1 --vertices 6 --radius1 0.09 --radius2 0 --depth 0.2 --location 0 0 0.3
select B0 B1
active B0
join
set rotation 0 -32 20
apply --rotation
set location -0.16 -0.05 0.12
apply --location
select M0 M1 A0 B0
active M0
join
rename M0 Shard
material assign Shard
select Plinth Shard
shade flat
export crystal.glb
